goal: Establish baseline: check whether office-ws-1 or dev.dana have ANY prior proxy access events in logs-squid.access in the 7 days before the alert (2026-07-21 to 2026-07-28).
what_to_summarize: Count of logs-squid.access events for host.name=office-ws-1 in 7d before 2026-07-28T07:06:53Z
Count of logs-squid.access events for user.name=dev.dana in 7d before 2026-07-28T07:06:53Z
Any prior proxy access events at all from office-ws-1 or by dev.dana
If any prior events exist: timestamps, URLs, and patterns

params.query:
FROM logs-squid.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-21T07:06:53Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T07:06:53Z"
        AND source.ip == "office-ws-1"
| STATS requests      = COUNT(*),
        denied        = COUNT(*) WHERE squid.result_status LIKE "*DENIED*",
        bytes_out     = SUM(http.response.bytes),
        distinct_dest = COUNT_DISTINCT(url.original),
        first_seen    = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen     = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY identity = user.name,
           method   = http.request.method
| SORT requests DESC

FROM logs-squid.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-21T07:06:53Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T07:06:53Z"
        AND user.name == "dev.dana"
| STATS requests      = COUNT(*),
        denied        = COUNT(*) WHERE squid.result_status LIKE "*DENIED*",
        bytes_out     = SUM(http.response.bytes),
        distinct_dest = COUNT_DISTINCT(url.original),
        first_seen    = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen     = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY source_ip = source.ip,
           method   = http.request.method
| SORT requests DESC

FROM logs-squid.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-21T07:06:53Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T07:06:53Z"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.6"
| STATS requests      = COUNT(*),
        denied        = COUNT(*) WHERE squid.result_status LIKE "*DENIED*",
        bytes_out     = SUM(http.response.bytes),
        distinct_dest = COUNT_DISTINCT(url.original),
        first_seen    = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen     = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY identity = user.name,
           method   = http.request.method
| SORT requests DESC

FROM logs-squid.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-21T07:06:53Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T07:06:53Z"
        AND user.name == "dev.dana"
| STATS requests      = COUNT(*),
        bytes_out     = SUM(http.response.bytes),
        first_seen    = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen     = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY dest = url.original
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-squid.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-21T07:06:53Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T07:06:53Z"
| STATS requests      = COUNT(*),
        first_seen    = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen     = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY source_ip = source.ip,
           identity = user.name
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 10

goal: Characterize the Squid proxy access burst from office-ws-1 around 2026-07-28T07:06:53Z — get all request URLs, HTTP methods, response bytes, elapsed time, result status, destination IPs/domains, and timing pattern.
what_to_summarize: All logs-squid.access events for host.name=office-ws-1 in ±30m of 2026-07-28T07:06:53Z
url.original for each request (full list of destination URLs)
http.request.method for each request (GET/CONNECT/etc)
http.response.bytes for each request
squid.elapsed_ms for each request
squid.result_status for each request
user.name for each request (confirm dev.dana)
source.ip for each request
Timing pattern: timestamps of each request, inter-request intervals
Total count of requests and total bytes transferred

params.query:
FROM logs-squid.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-28T06:36:53Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T07:36:53Z"
| KEEP @timestamp, source.ip, host.name, user.name, url.original, http.request.method, http.response.bytes, squid.elapsed_ms, squid.result_status
| SORT @timestamp ASC
| LIMIT 1000
